chars.NARRATOR: a skinny Moroccan young man of 19 with short curly black hair, wearing a mustard yellow hoodie, black track pants and white sneakers
chars.MOM: a strong Moroccan mother in her late 40s wearing a dark green djellaba and a white headscarf tied tightly, stern face
chars.BROTHER: a big tough Moroccan man around 30 with a shaved head, a scar across his cheek and a bruised swollen face, wearing a black leather jacket over a white tank top
chars.BROTHER2: a tall Moroccan man around 25 with a short beard, wearing a grey tracksuit with red stripes
chars.NEIGHBOUR: a Moroccan woman in her 50s wearing a purple floral house robe and a beige headscarf
chars.GUARD: an old Moroccan night guard with a grey moustache, wearing a navy blue coat and a wool beanie, holding a wooden stick

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Narrow popular Moroccan derb alley in the afternoon. The big tough man BROTHER grabs the young NARRATOR by the hoodie and pushes him against a whitewashed wall, shouting angrily in his face; the narrator looks terrified. Seen from a few steps away, head-to-waist framing, both faces visible, main action in the centre of the frame.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot in the derb alley: BROTHER with his scarred bruised prison face glaring menacingly at the camera, cracking his knuckles, BROTHER2 standing behind him with crossed arms. Intimidating, faces in the centre.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: The NARRATOR alone in his small bedroom at night, sitting on the edge of his bed, sweating and trembling with fear, hands on his head, wide scared eyes. Dim lamp light, face in the centre.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night in the derb alley under a yellow street lamp: the old night GUARD points his wooden stick and scolds the NARRATOR, who shrinks back ashamed. Head-to-waist framing, both faces visible in the centre.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Daytime at the green metal door of a neighbour's old house in a Moroccan popular neighbourhood: MOM stands at the doorstep with a determined face, the NEIGHBOUR woman opens the door surprised. Both faces visible in the centre.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Inside the neighbour's doorway: MOM raises her finger and firmly tells the NEIGHBOUR woman to keep quiet, the neighbour nods nervously with her hand on her chest. Head-to-waist framing, faces in the centre.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: View from the derb alley up toward an old house: a shadowy curious man watches from a small window with a half-open wooden shutter while the NARRATOR walks below looking over his shoulder nervously. The narrator's face visible in the centre.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan living room with traditional sedari sofas and a tea tray: MOM sits next to the NARRATOR and talks to him seriously with a caring but strict face, the narrator listens with his head down, regretful. Both faces visible in the centre.
